about.title: Colusa Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Colusa is a small place. With fewer than 6,000 residents, a death here rarely stays private, and grief tends to ripple through the whole town. Public records for 2025, the most recent final year, show six injury collisions and seven people hurt on Colusa streets, with no traffic fatalities that year. That is a relief, not a guarantee. Wrongful death claims also arise from farm and workplace accidents, unsafe properties, defective equipment, and medical errors, and a fatal crash on Rt 20, Fremont Street, Bridge Street or Market Street can change those numbers in a single afternoon. Under California law, a wrongful death case is a civil action brought by the spouse or domestic partner and children first, then by certain dependents or heirs. Families have two years from the date of death to file, and less time if a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Colusa families with an independent attorney who will explain what the loss of financial support, funeral costs, and companionship mean in legal terms, free of charge and with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children. The attorney you are connected with will confirm who in your family qualifies before any step is taken.

items.title: Deadlines Are Tracked for You
items.desc: Families generally have two years from the date of death to file, but the window shrinks when a city, county or state agency is involved. An independent attorney can flag those shorter deadlines right away.

items.title: Civil Recovery, Separate From Any Criminal Case
items.desc: A wrongful death claim proceeds on its own track, whether or not the district attorney files charges. The attorney can pursue funeral costs, lost support, and the loss of companionship even while a criminal matter is pending.

items.question: My spouse died in a crash on Rt 20 near Colusa. Do I have a wrongful death case?
items.answer: Possibly. If another driver, a trucking company, or a road agency acted negligently, a spouse is among the first people California law allows to bring a claim. Because Rt 20 is a state route, part of the case could involve a government entity, which means a much shorter filing deadline. It is worth speaking with an attorney soon rather than waiting.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges in Colusa County. Do we have to wait?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves independently of the criminal case. Your attorney may use evidence from the prosecution, but you do not need to wait for a verdict, and a criminal acquittal does not end a civil claim.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge Colusa families anything?
items.answer: No. Our connection service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorney you are matched with works on a contingency basis, so there is no attorney fee unless your family recovers compensation.
